decisions.reason: With only a 2019 standalone listing and no clear later evidence of failure, an established German wholesaler would likely keep this niche machine unless sales clearly fell below aspiration, and its age suggests enough slack to wait longer.

The fully automatic version fits a durable automation-oriented capital-equipment portfolio, so absent clear signs of underperformance relative to aspirations the firm would more likely retain it than redeploy resources.

This complementary booklet-making product is somewhat more exposed to niche-demand uncertainty, but with no definite signal of a large shortfall an older wholesaler would still likely keep it while continuing to assess results.
